item.title: The Saturday Night Monster
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: The Saturday Night Monster Late on Saturday nights, the most frightening monster of all enters our home. It drags me to the fridge, seizing my hands and coercing them into into the freezer section. Resistance, as they say, is futile. Before I know it, I’ve succumbed to it’s cruel overtures.
